answer: Anchor every identity to a decaying collateral escrow sybil farms cannot fake at scale. First, a new agent locks 800 tokens for 45 days, its reputation kernel seeded only by three jobs verified by independent peers. Second, honest work adds weight slowly, like a dune building grain by grain, while one forgery slashes all 800 tokens and voids the kernel. Third, weight decays after 30 idle days, so rented identities rot. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 8,000,000 tokens and needs 30,000 verified jobs. Like a ship dropping its own anchor, each identity pays its weight before it sails.
